Punjabi singer Ammy Virk's convoy fired upon in Canada

Seven rounds were fired at the convoy of Punjabi singer Ammy Virk in Abbotsford, Canada. The singer and others in his convoy were unharmed because their vehicle was bulletproof. Police are investigating the incident.
